subject: infra.cybersec
name: National cybersecurity strategy or response team
what_would_settle_it: the instrument establishing the national response team under the regulator, or a national cybersecurity strategy document with its approval date

subject: infra.energy
name: Energy provision for digital infrastructure
what_would_settle_it: a dated grid-reliability or generation-capacity figure from the utility, or a stated contracted load or power-purchase arrangement for any named Tanzanian data centre

subject: gov.legislate
name: Online content and cybercrime regulation
what_would_settle_it: the gazetted online content regulations or cybercrime Act text, or a dated regulator notice

subject: gov.standards
name: National data or interoperability standards instrument
what_would_settle_it: a published national data standard, interoperability framework or e-government standards circular with a date

subject: data.open
name: Open-data policy or national open-data portal
what_would_settle_it: an open-data policy document or a dated portal launch

subject: geopol.eu
name: EU-Tanzania digital governance instrument
what_would_settle_it: a signed EU-Tanzania digital partnership, adequacy arrangement or gateway instrument with a date

subject: data.satellite
name: Earth-observation or national geospatial data programme
what_would_settle_it: a ministry, regulator or lands primary naming a geospatial data programme with a dated status

subject: data.statistics
name: National statistical system objects
what_would_settle_it: a statistics-bureau primary or a statistics Act instrument with dated coverage

subject: digital.localgov
name: Local-government administrative and financial systems
what_would_settle_it: a local-government ministry or auditor-general primary naming a council-level system, its coverage across the 184 councils, and a dated figure

subject: geopol.usa
section: Artificial intelligence and the technology sector
name: United States technology-sector engagement
what_would_settle_it: a signed US-Tanzania digital or AI cooperation instrument, a named US cloud or AI vendor contract with a Tanzanian public body, or a dated development-finance technology commitment

subject: geopol.gulf
section: Artificial intelligence and the technology sector
name: Gulf-state technology or AI engagement
what_would_settle_it: a dated Gulf data-centre, AI or telecom investment in Tanzania with a named counterparty and value

subject: geopol.india
section: Artificial intelligence and the technology sector
name: India-Tanzania technology cooperation
what_would_settle_it: a dated India-Tanzania technology memorandum, or a funding and enrolment series for the Zanzibar campus

subject: capacity.research
name: National ICT or AI research programme or fund
what_would_settle_it: the science commission's budget or annual report, the higher-education project appraisal document, or a national AI or ICT research strategy
